BTS Group has been included in the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices for the eighth consecutive year

Back 23 February 2026

23 February 2026 - BTS Group Holdings PCL has been selected as an index constituent of the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI) Emerging Markets for the eighth consecutive year. This award reflects BTS Group’s continuous commitment to conducting business according to sustainable development principles. In addition, the Company was awarded the “Top 10%” in S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment and listed in the S&P Sustainability Yearbook 2026 by S&P Global for the eighth consecutive year. The Yearbook compiles information on leading organisations worldwide that have demonstrated outstanding performance within the sustainable business development framework in the environment, social and governance (ESG) dimensions.

The Sustainability Yearbook 2026 assessed over 9,200 companies across 59 industries. Out of the 848 companies worldwide to be included in the Sustainability Yearbook 2026, only 48 companies were from Thailand. BTS Group is listed in the Transportation and Transportation Infrastructure sector, which has a total of 27 industry peers.

The inclusion within the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook 2026 is a testament to BTS Group’s sustainability commitment to decarbonise the economy since day one. Leveraging from our 3M businesses: MOVE, MIX, and MATCH, our engagement across industries has allowed us to accelerate the change we need to enhance the community we serve and safeguard a sustainable future for future generations.
